latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of timezone-helper.

- Provides time zone conversion, current world clock, and meeting planning across time zones.
- Includes built-in IANA timezone data for 200+ cities; works fully offline with no dependencies.
- Supports daylight saving time information and transitions for major regions.
- Offers detailed output formats: single conversion, world clock, meeting planner, and DST queries.
- Handles ambiguous abbreviations and partial city names with internal mapping logic.
- Designed for ease of use—works anywhere, no API key or scripting required.
